listing.name: UAF Arma Addon
listing.summary: I am a big fan of Arma Armatura's pilotable strikecraft and UAF fighters so decided to combine them together. This mod adds pilotable UAF fighters using Arma Armatura's strikecraft system. You can find them in UAF markets and illegal weapon dealers.
listing.aiSummary: Adds pilotable UAF fighters using Arma Armatura's strikecraft system.

description:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1SexzYUqlUwiePKrN8iesYEEMoQwSOBmX/view?usp=drive_link

Requires Arma Armatura v3.0.6 BETA and United Aurora Federation 0.75c (Hotfix 3) alongside any dependencies

Disclaimer: This is just a one off thing, and I probably won't maintain it for long so it will likely be incompatible with any future updates for either mods. Also might not be save compatible.

I am a big fan of Arma Armatura's pilotable strikecraft and UAF fighters so decided to combine them together. This mod adds pilotable UAF fighters using Arma Armatura's strikecraft system. You can find them in UAF markets and illegal weapon dealers. It is also added to the UAF fighter blueprint package.

This is my first mod, so there may be bugs or balance issues. Feedback is welcome.

All credits go to the creators of UAF and Arma Armatura
